literal_meaning: চরণের সেবা (feet service or worshipping the feet)
figurative_meaning_en: sarcastically, to flatter or appease obsequiously
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বসের চরণসেবা করে প্রমোশন পেয়েছে।
রাজনীতিতে চরণসেবা ছাড়া কিছু পাওয়া যায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: He got the promotion by bootlicking his boss.
In politics, nothing is achieved without kissing up to the powerful.
note: The idiom draws from the literal act of foot-worship in devotional contexts but is used sarcastically to denote insincere flattery.
